name: Violet Crow
rangeDescription: Southern moluccas (seram, buru, and ambon)
description: An entirely blackish short-tailed crow. Has a subtle purplish sheen that is visible in only certain lighting conditions.

name: Bertram's Weaver
rangeDescription: Highlands of tanzania, zambia, malawi, and northern mozambique
description: Fairly large, chunky weaver. Both sexes have a pale eye, an olive back, and yellow underparts.

name: Virginia's Warbler
rangeDescription: Mountains of southwestern usa; winters to southwestern mexico
description: A mostly gray warbler with yellow undertail coverts and a thin white eyering. All but the dullest immatures show a yellow patch on the breast.

name: Hazel-fronted Pygmy-Tyrant
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of southern peru (puno) and western bolivia
description: Small brown flycatcher found in humid forest from southern Peru to central Bolivia. Very plain; adults have a faint rusty tinge on the head, but this is lacking in young birds.

name: Indian Silverbill
rangeDescription: Arabian peninsula to southeastern iran, india, sri lanka, nepal, and sikkim
description: Small, long-tailed finch with a chunky body and short, stout bill. Gray-brown above and pale below with a whitish rump and black-pointed tail.

name: White-lored Oriole
rangeDescription: Northern philippines (montane forest of luzon)
description: A medium-sized bird of lowland forest and edge in the lowlands and lower mountains on Luzon. Overall yellow in color, slightly darker on the wings and tail, with a reddish bill and a white mark between the bill and the brown eye.

name: Sichuan Partridge
rangeDescription: Southwestern china (hills of south-central sichuan)
description: A rare and retiring partridge of mixed forest, found only in the south-central portion of China’s Sichuan province. If seen well, combination of orange cheek patch, striped white throat, and broad maroon chest band is diagnostic.

name: Gray-backed Storm-Petrel
rangeDescription: Circumpolar subantarctic waters, north to about 35°s
description: A very small seabird of southern oceans. Gray-black on head, neck, throat, and top of breast.

name: Gray-browed Wren
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of northern peru (south of río marañón)
description: Bamboo-loving wren found locally on the eastern slope of the Andes in northern Peru. Brown and gray overall with black and white face and mustache stripes.

name: Black-capped Siskin
rangeDescription: Coniferous forest of southern mexico (chiapas) and western guatemala
description: Scarce and local small finch of highlands in Chiapas and Guatemala. Favors pine-oak forests, edges, and adjacent clearings, especially with alders.
imageCreditName: Esteban Matías (birding guide) Sierra de los Cuchumatanes Huehuetenango esteban.matias@hotmail.com +502 53810540

name: Bearded Guan
rangeDescription: Andes of southern ecuador (but not the east slope) and western andes of northwestern peru
description: Large chickenlike bird with a long tail. Chocolate-brown overall with pinkish-red legs and silvery frosting on head and neck.

name: Cuzco Brushfinch
rangeDescription: Andes of southeastern peru (cusco) and far western bolivia (la paz)
description: Dark sparrow-like bird with a restricted range in the Andes of southern Peru. Dark gray with a reddish-orange crown.

name: Blue-capped Cordonbleu
rangeDescription: Far southeastern south sudan, far southeastern ethiopia, southern somalia, kenya, and tanzania
description: A slim, long-tailed, pretty waxbill. The upperparts are pale brown, the underparts and tail blue, and the bill pink.

name: Glaucous-blue Grosbeak
rangeDescription: Eastern paraguay to southern brazil, uruguay, and northeastern argentina
description: A medium-sized bulky finchlike species with a small head and a thick bill. Males are blue overall with a glossy blue forehead and rump.

name: Beautiful Jay
rangeDescription: Western andes of southwestern colombia and northwestern ecuador (south to pichincha)
description: Blue and gray jay with a black mask and white crown. It’s restricted to Andean cloud forest in northwestern Ecuador and western Colombia.

name: Giant Weaver
rangeDescription: São tomé (gulf of guinea)
description: A spectacular enormous weaver endemic to São Tomé, with a robust barbet-like bill and a bulky head. Adult male has a black head and a chestnut collar that extends to the breast.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Puna Thistletail
rangeDescription: Andes of southern peru (southern cusco and puno)
description: Small brown bird with a very long, thin tail. Found in elfin forest and montane scrub around and above the treeline, where it forages singly or in pairs low in dense vegetation.

name: Tenerife Blue Chaffinch
rangeDescription: Tenerife (canary islands)
description: Endemic to the island of Tenerife in the Canary Islands. Medium-sized finch with a strong and heavy bill and broken white eyering.

name: Caucasian Grouse
rangeDescription: Caucasus mountains, from far southwestern russia eastward to northeastern azerbaijan and southward to northeastern turkey, armenia, and far northwestern iran
description: Large gamebird endemic to the mountains of the Caucasus region. Male is jet-black with a tiny white patch on the shoulder, a tail that curves downwards at the tip, and flaming red “eyebrows.” White underwing patches are displayed during jumping lekking display.

name: Tschudi's Nightjar
rangeDescription: Arid littoral of western peru and far northern chile
description: Fairly common but nocturnal bird of lowland desert with scattered low bushes and agricultural areas with hedges and brush. Sleeps during the day on the ground or on a low shady perch; when flushed flies with quick stiff wingbeats and short glides.
